correctness.rationale: The all-size safety theorem follows by stable reference survival, hospital-optimality in both the pruned and full markets, and exclusion of any omitted original blocking edge. At n≤2, every pruned proposer-optimal matching is a perfect hospitalwise improvement of a surviving stable reference; if distinct it swaps two partners and cannot have any hospital-favored omitted pair. At n=3 exact strict lists have a unique full stable reference (checked by all six permutations), one exact-window removed edge, and a unique verified original blocking pair in pruned DA. Included finite checker passes 290 n≤2 pruning instances and 1,531,392 n=3 safe-direction combinations. No inference from finite tests to infinite sizes.

value.rationale: The motivating contemporary model treats hospitals dropping interviews/proposals around exact rank estimates. The novel joint (n=3, one omitted pair) cutoff sharply quantifies the fragility of hospital-proposing DA even when prediction is exact and the stable benchmark unique; n≤2 and zero omission genuinely forbid this phenomenon. The universal safe-pruning lemma separates deleting candidates below the reference partner from deleting above, even with irregular retained subsets. This is a structural minimum threshold and practical algorithmic guardrail, not an arbitrary table recomputation.
